summary: Clash Royale entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Clash Royale

emulation.notes: Use the current native or official release route where available.

primary.why: Clash Royale is playable on PC through Google Play Games with larger screen, mouse/keyboard controls, seamless mobile/PC sync, and streaming suitability. That preserves the live mobile service while improving capture fidelity.
primary.how_to_play: Play through Google Play Games on Windows with Supercell ID sync. Record season, arena, card pool, and patch/date because balance and events are live-service content.

all_releases.fidelity: Original/current mobile route through App Store and Google Play.
all_releases.reason: skip: authentic mobile route, but official PC route has better capture and same account/service sync.

all_releases.platform: Windows PC via Google Play Games
all_releases.fidelity: Official PC route with larger screen, mouse/keyboard, sync, and streaming suitability.
all_releases.reason: primary: best archive capture route for the same live game.
